summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new Jornada (Shift Journal) feature and the AI Daily Summary markdown rendering fix. 12/12 backend pytest tests PASS against the public preview URL (auth gate, OCR round-trip with tiny synthetic JPEG, fuel append, zero-amount rejection, close + totals computation with all 8 required keys, second-start-after-close allowed, 409 when open, sorted list with limit, manual override recomputes totals on closed journals, delete + verify-removed). Frontend smoke: Gestión tab shows the new 'Jornada con foto del taxímetro' section with the green 'FOTO INICIO DE JORNADA' CTA at the top and the existing manual calculator (40/45/50%, ¿Pagas tú la gasolina?, Datos del turno) remains intact BELOW it. Eventos tab shows the AI daily summary with **bold** rendered as styled bold (no literal asterisks) and section headers like METEO HOY, GRANDES EVENTOS, TEATROS Y OCIO, ALERTAS DE TRÁFICO, AEROPUERTO, PREVISIÓN MAÑANA rendered as violet bold uppercase WITHOUT the [brackets].

minor.issue: Deprecation: server.py still uses @app.on_event(startup/shutdown) — migrate to lifespan context manager (carried over from iteration_10).
Gemini OCR errors are wrapped as 502; if Gemini returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED the test would skip — consider mapping 429 → 503 with Retry-After like daily_summary regenerate.

action_items: Optional: map Gemini 429 → HTTP 503 with Retry-After in /app/backend/routers/journal.py (mirror the cleanup already suggested for daily_summary).
Optional cleanup: migrate the two remaining @app.on_event handlers in /app/backend/server.py to FastAPI lifespan.

Optional UX: add data-testid attributes to the Gestión 'FOTO INICIO DE JORNADA' button and the page-selector dropdown items (Calle, Gestión, Eventos…). Tests currently rely on text labels, which is fragile if translations change.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/journal.py: clean and self-contained (~470 lines). _strip_id helper used everywhere, Mongo _id correctly excluded via projection {"_id":0}, async + asyncio.to_thread used for the blocking Gemini call. Pydantic models validate the manual-override payload before merging. Good.

routers/journal.py /manual endpoint silently ignores unknown keys (only fields in ParcialReading.model_fields are merged). Consider returning a 422 if the override payload has keys the model rejects, to give the driver immediate feedback that 'tiempo_libre' (for example) is not a valid field.

routers/journal.py _save_photo writes to /app/backend/uploads/parciales/ which is local disk — fine for preview but if the container is replaced these images are lost. For production consider S3/GCS or at least a mounted persistent volume.
/app/backend/server.py remains 4448+ lines — well above the 700-line guideline; keep extracting routers (the new journal router is a good example of the target style).
test_credentials: admin / admin via POST /api/auth/login — confirmed working, returns valid JWT used for all /api/journal/* calls.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 2 journals tagged via the synthetic 200×200 JPEG and DELETEs them at the end. No persistent data leaks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend journal feature is fully wired and verified end-to-end against the public preview URL https://tariff-tool.preview.emergentagent.com. The synthetic 200×200 white JPEG used in tests is intentionally tiny — Gemini returns null for most OCR fields (that's fine; we only assert the round trip works and totals math is correct). Manual override is the path that exercises real numeric values. If you want to dry-run without burning Gemini quota, the 12 tests already share a session but still call Gemini twice per run (start + end + second start). Frontend uses Expo router; the Gestión section is rendered by /app/frontend/app/index.tsx around lines 13028–13234. Markdown bold renderer is at lines 12660–12698 and works correctly. Recommended improvements (non-blocking) are listed under critical_code_review_comments.
